input.rationale: Section 4 deals only with term, notice of termination and the Termination Payment, and no other provision (including Section 8 Confidentiality and Section 10.7 Survival) requires return, export or deletion of Company data or any wind-down assistance. In a hosting arrangement where HDI holds our Content, user information and customer data, that absence falls below the fallback, so we insert a new Section 4.3 at the preferred position: up to six months' transition assistance at HDI's then-current rates, return of Company data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after expiry or termination, and deletion with written certification thereafter.

ops.text: 4.3 Transition Assistance; Return of Company Data. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, HDI shall (a) at the Company's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for a period of up to six (6) months at HDI's then-current rates; (b) return to the Company all Content, user information, customer data and other Company data in HDI's possession or control in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after expiry or termination; and (c) thereafter delete such Content, information and data from its systems and certify such deletion to the Company in writing.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no exit mechanic, so we add Section 4.3: up to six months' transition assistance at HDI's then-current rates, return of our Content, user information and customer data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after expiry or termination, and deletion with written certification thereafter.
proposal.summary: Insert Section 4.3 transition assistance and data return/deletion
